ops.text: c. In addition, TrueLink shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless Client and its affiliates, directors, officers, employees and agents from and against all claims, actions, expenses, losses and liabilities, including reasonable attorneys' fees, arising from or relating to any third-party claim to the extent arising out of (i) an allegation that the Interface, the Hosting Services, the Support Services or any other materials or services provided by TrueLink infringe or misappropriate any copyright, patent, trade secret, trademark or other intellectual property right; (ii) TrueLink's violation of any applicable law, rule or regulation; (iii) any unauthorized access to or disclosure of Client Content or Client Confidential Information caused by TrueLink; or (iv) TrueLink's gross negligence or willful misconduct.

input.comment: [Playbook] We added a TrueLink indemnity for third-party intellectual property claims, its breach of law, TrueLink-caused data breaches and its gross negligence or willful misconduct, since the current Section 12(b) covers only breach of the Agreement and leaves us exposed on infringement claims relating to TrueLink's own Interface and services. If helpful, we can accept an IP-only indemnity with the usual exclusions (our modifications, combinations and specifications) and procure/modify/replace/refund remedies.
input.summary: Add TrueLink indemnity for third-party IP infringement, breach of law, data breach and willful misconduct.
